title: paperlint: deterministic pre-submission gates for manuscripts and research repositories
description: A command-line tool that verifies published claims about research artefacts: page counts, recorded hashes and byte sizes, citation/bibliography parity, figure rendering determinism, Word template structure, CI workflow wiring and deposit records. Every check is independent and the exit code is the contract. A run that executes zero checks exits non-zero, because a silently skipped audit reads as a pass.
